_readme: OpenCode Go (Zen) $/1M-token rates for the frontier cohort's subscription-estimate label.

Source: https://opencode.ai/docs/zen — captured on 2026-10-05 (the as-of date for every entry in this table; rates drift, so a re-derivation against an older table will under- or over-charge the subscription-estimate costUsd field).

Each entry is USD per million tokens, sliced into input/output. Subscription routes drain the pre-paid allowance at the model's published $/1M rates; this table is the rate the runner uses to stamp pricing: subscription-estimate and costUsd. Re-derive the table from the docs URL above; the table is committed here so a chart's costUsd is auditable against its row, not a live API.
Cost is computed per-eval (computeCost in src/report.mjs):

USD rounded to 6dp. The label is always subscription-estimate for a Go run with usage — never pay-per-token (no model.price on the provider) and never unpriced (a run with usage carries a published rate).

Tokens with a tier boundary (e.g. <= 272K vs > 272K) are recorded as one row per tier so a chart reader can match the published tier to the run's prompt-token count. The runner uses the FIRST matching tier's rate (the smaller-token tier); a future refinement could pick the actual tier, but that needs a prompt-tokens field on the report shape we don't yet stamp.
Adding a new model: copy one entry, change the model name and rates, leave the rest of the entry alone. Re-derive the table from the docs URL — do NOT type in numbers you don't have a source for.
